title: Red Warrior Pose Study
description: Two side-by-side poses of the same female character with long black and red hair, wearing a red and black gothic outfit with corset, chain details, short jagged skirt, and heavy black boots. The left pose shows her hands raised defensively to her head while the right shows her in a fighting stance with fists clenched.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long flowing black hair with red streaks, wearing a revealing red and black gothic punk outfit with studded corset, chain accessories, short jagged red skirt, red fingerless gloves, and heavy black lace-up boots. Shown in two poses side by side against a plain grey background: one with hands raised near her head in a defensive stance, the other in an aggressive fighting pose with fists forward, dynamic anime-influenced digital painting style.
